title: Signed Magnitude Comparator
statement: Design a signed magnitude comparator that compares two 8-bit values treated as signed integers. The outputs should indicate greater-than, equal, and less-than relationships in signed two’s complement form. The comparator should work for negative and positive operands.
module_signature: module sign_magnitude_comparator(input signed [7:0] a, input signed [7:0] b, output gt, output eq, output lt);
behavior: gt is 1 when a > b as signed numbers.
Purely combinational: outputs must settle after input changes.
Do not depend on initial register values, clocks, or delays.
All outputs must be driven to known 0/1 values for every input case.
constraints: Do not use sequential logic or internal registers.
hint: Signed comparison is different from unsigned comparison when the sign bits differ.
